text_block_list.name: Previously on...
text_block_list.text: The story so far!

text_block_list.name: Previously on...
text_block_list.text:
Set in modern times, not long ago in a 
faraway land. Kiseki, longing to be the 
protagonist of her own story, takes on the 
Twinkle Series alongside her Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Previously on...
text_block_list.text:
However, the road along the way has its 
ups and downs. Slumps constantly lurk, 
bringing dilemmas and loss of creativity.

text_block_list.name: Previously on...
text_block_list.text:
However! Every single time, Kiseki 
experienced an encounter! An encounter 
with the light to overcome all hardships!!

text_block_list.name: Previously on...
text_block_list.text:
And so, having gathered about 8 lights... 
roughly 8, probably, Kiseki awakened!

text_block_list.name: Previously on...
text_block_list.text:
I could feel it! That I truly can become 
the protagonist!!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"...That's right! I'm the main 
character!!"

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! Did you see the URA Awards press 
conference!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"That press conference" was a major 
announcement that shook the world.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I have an announcement for everyone. I, 
Kitasan Blackâ

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
As of today, I'm going on an extended 
break!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"...Still, the Twinkle Series won't feel 
lonely just because I took a little 
break!"

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
A "festival girl" like me will show up! A 
festival girl who brings smiles to 
everyone's faces!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
To be honest, I still can't believe it... 
To think that Kita-chan would...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
To Kiseki, Kitasan Black had always been 
the "protagonist of the era," shining 
brightly up ahead.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She's not here. That will likely have 
quite an impact on Kiseki.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
For the Takarazuka Kinen, we've definitely 
gotta do the "Decisive Battle for the 
Strongest Arc"!!
choice_data_list:
Hm!? "The Battle for the Strongest 
Arc"...!?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
That's the reaction I was waiting for! Now 
then—allow me to explain!!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
The "Battle for the Strongest Arc" is, 
just like the name says, a story about 
fighting to decide who's the strongest!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
In battle manga, it's something like a 
martial arts tournament! In sports manga, 
it's the national tournament! Most famous 
ones use a tournament bracket, but—

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"The most entertaining part of this 
'Ultimate Championship Arc' is precisely 
how 'strong rivals appear one after 
another'!"

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
In other words, the dynamic is quite 
similar to the spring finale, the 
Takarazuka Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Yes! The Takarazuka is a Grand Prix race. 
Basically, the right to run is granted to 
the most popular Umamusume!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
That's why powerhouse runners who made a 
splash in spring GⅠs like the Osaka Hai 
and Tenno Sho (Spring) will be gathering. 
...Which means~?
choice_data_list:
This kind of feels like a "Battle for the 
Strongest Arc"...!?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Right!? It's a race many Umamusume aim for 
to begin with. Even without doing 
anything, the strongest will surely 
gather.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"Still, we're gonna hype it up even more 
this year!! I'll reach out to tons of 
Umamusume myself and help bring together a 
massive lineup of rivals!"

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Even without Kita-chan, we'll make this 
the most exciting race ever!!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
The Umamusume who triumphs in this 
ultimate showdown will truly be the 
"protagonist of the new era."

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
The protagonist of this era—is gonna be 
me.
choice_data_list:
Kiseki is going to be the hero of a new 
era...!!

text_block_list.text: I cannot overlook that, challenger!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Ah, that voice is—

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
You're from the same Satono family as 
Dia-chan, and in the same generation as 
Kita-chan! Satono Crown-chan!!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes...? Thank you for the detailed 
explanation. ...*cough*!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
That very Satono Crown now gives you her 
verdict.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
The throne of stardom that Kitasan has 
held onto is the very seat that our entire 
generation has been aiming for.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
點只得你一個？ ...You weren't the only one 
eyeing that seat.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"—Before we race, let's see how good your 
tactics are first! In the Umamusume TCG, 
"UmaDuel Racer 2"!!"

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Wh-Whaaat?!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"Uma Duel Racer 2"! A trading card game 
based on popular Umamusume!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Playtime is reduced even further from the 
original version! With multimedia 
expansions like manga and anime 
succeeding, every Umamusume knows this 
game!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
If you don't have one on hand, I can lend 
you one of my decks. Front Runner, Leader, 
Betweener, Chaser... whichever you prefer?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Kuh, they don't even care that their 
tactics got leaked...? Just how skilled is 
this runner...?!
choice_data_list:
(What has she been talking about this 
whole time?)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
So basically, is it like an Umamusume race 
translated into a game? I don't know the 
full details, but...
choice_data_list: (But it does look kind of interesting!)

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
What should I do... What do I do...! How 
do I conquer this duel...?!
choice_data_list:
I'll battle you with a basic frontrunner 
deck!

Let's battle with a basic frontrunner 
deck!

Keh heh heh... You should win this one as 
a closer...!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
What should I do... What do I do...! How 
do I conquer this duel...?!
choice_data_list:
I'll battle you with a basic frontrunner 
deck!

Let's battle with a basic frontrunner 
deck!

Keh heh heh... You should win this one as 
a closer...!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Wah♪ It looks like you know the rules to 
some extent too, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Because in "Uma Duel Racer 2", racers are 
allowed to have a trusted advisor by their 
side!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"Alright, advisor, let's start by building 
a deck!"

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Adding a Tactic Card! "Tactic Card: 
Eternal Radiance Illuminating the Dark"!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Wh-what...?! That's a tactic tied to Dia! 
To combine that with Satono Crown's 
Umamusume Card...!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Beyond theory lies synergy! Aim for the 
goooooaaaal!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Kiseki got absorbed in playing 
games with Satono Crown... ...getting a 
nice, refreshing break right from New 
Year's.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"—Kiseki's race is far from over!" 
...Whoops!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Ah...! You're right. No matter what 
strategy they use, running Pace gives us 
the flexibility to adapt...!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Oh? ...Are you sure about that?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
I'm the Umamusume... who has made Kitasan 
Black her rival, you know?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: WAAAAAAAHHH---!?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Front-runners, pace-setters... Just how 
many times have I lost to opponents who 
specialize in those styles?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Did you really think that I wouldn't take 
any countermeasures?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Kh, damn it...! Dammiiiiiiit!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"...Give me a rematch, Crown-chan...! 
Whether it's a duel or a real race...! 
Next time, I'm the one who's gonna...!!"

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"I accept your challenge. However, you 
will be the one facing defeat once again."

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: That's! Not! TRUUUUE!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And just like that, Kiseki gained a new 
rival!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"On the road to the Takarazuka Kinen, even 
more formidable rivals are sure to 
await!!"

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"—Kiseki's race is far from over!" 
...Whoops!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: "Huh, Trainer!? What character is that!?"

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I've never heard of that! Is it a work I 
haven't read yet!? Please tell me! I want 
to know!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even so, I only said that line to go along 
with the mood of the moment. My face 
begins to burn hotter and hotter...

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
...More importantly! Kiseki-san, weren't 
you supposed to have a duel?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Gasp!!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
And Trainer, you too! If you don't know 
the rules, please ask! Since we're all 
here, let's have fun together!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Satono Crown shoots me a wink. It seems 
her quick wit saved the day...

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Kyaaah!? To think my tactic card would be 
destroyed...!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
You're the one to talk, Crown-chan...! My 
LP is on the verge of running out 
here~...!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki & Crown
text_block_list.text: Race points are— Race points are—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, while having fun playing games 
with Kiseki and the others, we spent a 
peaceful New Year's.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"—Kiseki's race is far from over!" 
...Whoops!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, now things are getting 
interesting!! Let's keep this momentum 
going into the Takarazuka with Crown-chan 
too—!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
The throne of stardom that Kitasan has 
held onto is the very seat that our entire 
generation has been aiming for.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ...You're right.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
You're in the same generation as 
Kita-chan, after all. It makes you think 
"I'm next!" all the more, doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ――...But still!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Let's compete! And go for the win! Because 
I'm the one who's gonna make everything 
from here on a masterpiece!
